newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. investor has 6.0 pct MicroFrame stake.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. investor has 6.0 pct MicroFrame stake.

text.p: Jules Nordlicht, an investor from Long Beach, N.Y., said Tuesday he holds the equivalent of a 6.0 percent or 300,000 common shares in MicroFrame Inc.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Nordlicht said he purchased 100,000 units of Framework at $1.25 a unit earlier this year.

Each unit consists of one common share and one class A warrant to buy one additional share at $1.50 a share, and one class B warrant to buy a common share at $2.00 a share. The warrants expire four years from the grant date, he said.
He said he holds the stake for investment.
